errors.bad_args: The analyser got arguments it cannot read: {reason}
errors.no_breakpoint: Nothing to write: no breakpoint was selected.

hints.dynamic: {path}: {name} is not statically readable; the breakpoints the pages use still count.
hints.presets: {path}: the screens of Tailwind presets are not read; the pages still show those in use.
hints.range: {path}: the screen {name} is a range or a raw query, not a breakpoint, and was left out.

reasons.boundary: A media query changes the layout at {width} px ({count} times).
reasons.declared: Declared in {source}; no media query of the analysed pages uses it yet.
reasons.desktop: A large desktop view above the widest breakpoint.
reasons.edge: One pixel beside the boundary at {boundary} px.
reasons.group: The average of the breakpoints between {from} and {to} px.
reasons.mobile: The smallest mobile view, below every breakpoint.

tools.apply: Writes the chosen breakpoints of the last proposal into .rbrowser/config.json.
tools.detect: Reads the media queries of the site and proposes breakpoints, without writing.
